sources.title: Ravens were reportedly concerned about Maxx Crosby's degenerative knee issue for beyond 2026 season
sources.description: It's been two weeks since the Baltimore Ravens backed out of their deal to trade for Las Vegas Raiders star pass rusher Maxx Crosby for two first-round picks.
